notes: Not AGW's own document — a compiled multi-federation roundup (rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy) reproducing the fed's own results third-hand, so no page is served for it (canonical-copy). First actual AGW show/card content this project holds for the wing's "since 1997" era, predating and corroborating its existing RSPWF-Top-200-tag-only 1997 evidence. Two segments, apparently in date order (the numbering continues an earlier, undated week's report before the 15 April header starts a fresh count): (1) an undated, earlier AGW card closing out a "Lethal Lottery" tag tournament (won by Brolly & Abdullah the Butcher), Dark Rogue winning the vacant TV Title from Steve Austin, Black Mage winning the Cruiserweight Title from Doc Holiday, and a stable-vs-stable elimination angle (World of Fear def. NDA) whose own text states the losing NDA wrestlers "have to leave AGW for at least a few months" — a mass-departure angle; (2) this dated 15 April "Anything Goes Tuesday" card itself, 34 matches, including Dark Rogue's own successful TV Title defense against Methos, an Intercontinental Title tournament (won by Thrash), and Duke Of Beav winning the World Title from Mama Jama in a Casket match. Continuity into 1998 corroborated by two further Top-200/review twin-pairs in the same partition (already broadly expected by the held row). Full match-by-match detail is not reproduced here beyond the roster/title facts above; the great majority of named wrestlers in this report are not otherwise minted in this wing and are left uncaptured rather than force-minted from a third-party digest.
